# pacman.conf(5) defines Architecture as `auto` (uname -m) or an explicit list
# and always permits `any`; it does not publish a closed format-wide vocabulary:
# https://man.archlinux.org/man/pacman.conf.5.en#Architecture
# Pinned libalpm compares each package's `%ARCH%` literally with the configured
# architecture strings (apart from `any`):
# https://gitlab.archlinux.org/pacman/pacman/-/blob/54d94116164b0b2202c6061c4a59c6f3e70820d8/lib/libalpm/trans.c#L69-106
# The installed /etc/makepkg.conf substitutes the exact values below.
CARCH=x86_64
CHOST=x86_64-pc-linux-gnu
# Exact `%ARCH%` values observed for the supported `arch` x86_64 profile in the
# pinned 2026-08-02 core, extra, and multilib databases. The supported-profile
# registry owns that profile's admitted tokens; this snapshot is not a
# format-wide ALPM token table.
# URLs:
# https://archive.archlinux.org/repos/2026/08/02/core/os/x86_64/core.db
# https://archive.archlinux.org/repos/2026/08/02/extra/os/x86_64/extra.db
# https://archive.archlinux.org/repos/2026/08/02/multilib/os/x86_64/multilib.db

PACKAGE_ARCH=x86_64
